capture_notes: URL mode reads server-delivered HTML; it does not execute arbitrary application JavaScript.
For client-rendered apps use a fully loaded SingleFile capture. App-specific UI behavior still needs an adapter.
No claim of pixel-perfect rendering is made without browser visual comparison.
limitations: Conversion cannot recover backend source, missing states or uncaptured video.
Original app scripts are removed. SRM UI uses a dedicated adapter; arbitrary app behavior needs reconstruction.
Network connections and form submission are disabled. No registration or email is sent.
